dependency_scope: Active Phase-B production/config and latest accepted final-closure harness; historical one-shot scripts counted separately, not promises of historical rerun reproducibility

historical_script_reference_search.breakdown: 42 historical harness/helper files plus the already closed final one-shot harness

latest_harness_source_evidence.finding: Source-only authority collection explicitly never enumerates historical artifact trees; inherits construction/config utilities from PD2, not old history gates.
Final OUT refers to its own closed smoke fixture. Full checkpoint replay after deleting tensors is not retained; no active production reader depends on this old fixture.

classification_guidance.keep_override_priority: All tracked files, all source/helper scripts, Markdown reports and current/historical authority remain protected regardless of this shortlist.
classification_guidance.compact_receipt_selection: Only top-level or direct formal01/process_a/process_b JSON files <=102400 bytes whose names denote final result, failure/STOP adjudication, supervisor result, quiescence, root-cause reproduction or qualification summary; nested fixture/preflight copies excluded.
classification_guidance.historical_dependency_impact: Original forensic scripts and original inventory locks may no longer replay after approved deletion. This is HISTORICAL_ONLY and not an active runtime breakage; do not edit frozen source/receipts to disguise it.
classification_guidance.markdown_exception_reason: Diagnostic 160-row transaction table explicitly retains poisoned STOP nonclaim. Never delete parent tree wholesale.
classification_guidance.r14_reason: Keep one canonical copy of seven modest ledgers plus seven witnesses and compact source/config/runtime receipts; delete per-update progress/S10/pw records, bulk normalization/final/authority dumps and duplicate ledgers. This preserves direct normal-horizon evidence at approximately megabytes rather than gigabytes.
classification_guidance.r14_final_result_distinction: Retain 931-byte final_result.json with STOP classification; 82,663,470-byte prefixed *_final_result.json is redundant raw aggregate, not accepted compact final authority.
classification_guidance.generic_regex_is_not_deletion_authority: The explicit keep_paths below are a retention recommendation only; main audit must enumerate separate exact delete allowlists and protect any extra tracked files.

r14_retained_claims.source_hash_snapshot: r14_static_authority_snapshot.json retains the exact environment, full transaction and real adapter source hashes cited by readiness.
r14_retained_claims.config: process_config_authority.json retains T/E/M/N=2/2/3/12, ValueNorm, CUDA, epochs/minibatches and actual 30-second/300-step horizon.
r14_retained_claims.lifecycle_selection: W2 selected env1/robot1/task10 claim physical step23 tx12, completion step30 tx15, reopen step31 tx16; full canonical lifecycle ledger retained for independent inspection.
r14_retained_claims.terminal_and_post_reset: W5 terminal transaction150 keys (0,0,298)/(1,0,298), W6 fresh learned transaction151.
r14_retained_claims.historical_classification: PHASE-B2-T4-RE6-R14-STOP-POISONED-RETAINED remains unchanged; retained subsystem observations do not authorize learner reuse.

affected_report_links.action: R14 directory root and compact direct evidence stay present; duplicate/raw members may disappear after future approval.
Keep report and compact failure/final/quiescence receipts; full Layer-A dump reconstruction is intentionally not retained.
Keep transaction_table.md and STOP receipts; raw-ledger/detail links can become unavailable after separately approved deletion.
All 23 compact JSON remain protected; checkpoint generation manifest link remains while nine tensor components may be removed later; manifest alone is no longer loadable checkpoint.
